summary: Focused retest for iteration19 completed on requested fixes and interrupted admin/customer own-template flow. Most regressions now pass; one functional gap remains for creating fixed (non-editable) text in admin template editor.

ui_bugs.issue: `field-customer-editable` checkbox did not reliably toggle off while creating second text layer, preventing deterministic setup of one fixed text + one required customer text in the same template.

integration_issues.issue: Because checkbox toggle failed in repeated runs, final template ended up with two customer text fields instead of one fixed + one customer-required field.

After fix, re-run a short admin-template authoring check to verify one fixed + one required field is enforceable and shown correctly in customer simple mode.
Optional hardening: add UI test for `field-customer-editable` state transition (checked->unchecked->checked).

rca of the issue: RCA (remaining bug): while editing a selected text layer in AdminTemplateEditor, clicking `field-customer-editable` can leave checked state unchanged. This blocks reliable conversion to fixed content. Reproduction: create template -> add second text layer -> click customer-editable checkbox to disable -> state can remain checked. Mitigation: verify controlled checkbox binding and selected-layer state updates in TemplateFieldSettings/update path; add assertion test for state transition persistence.
